patterns: APPSC asks direct definitions: insolation = incoming solar radiation, highest albedo = snow, process-mechanism matching (advection horizontal, convection vertical), seasonal range maximum in high latitudes.
UPSC/other PSCs recur on why cloudy nights are warmer (clouds reflect back terrestrial radiation), continentality and annual range, January isotherms bending, hottest latitudes near 20-30 N.
Heat budget, GWP, inversion types and IMD heat/cold wave thresholds appear in app MCQs but not in PYQs; APPSC depth here is basic NCERT.
App MCQs use many statement/match items with numeric detail (27 cloud units, 6/9/19 split, 47 C severe heatwave) beyond what PYQs show.
